meta.rationale: Analysis of the CME associated with the X1.8 flare suggests further enhancement 10 Oct into 11 Oct, reaching G4 (Severe) levels is likely with G5 (Extreme) levels possible. G1 (Minor) conditions are expected on 12 Oct as CME influence wanes.
S2-S3 (Moderate-Strong) solar radiation storm levels are expected to continue through 10 Oct and begin a slow recovery through the rest of the period.
R1-R2 (Minor-Moderate) radio blackouts are expected, with a chance for isolated R3 (Strong or greater) radio blackout events through 12 Oct.

G4 (Severe) levels occurred early on 11 Oct. G1-G3 (Minor-Strong) levels are expected for the rest of the UTC day due to persistent CME activity. G1 (Minor) levels are expected on 12 Oct due to residual CME activity and possible CH HSS.
S1 (Minor) solar radiation storms were observed early in the period but have since dropped below threshold.
Solar activity is likely to be moderate (R1-R2, Minor-Moderate) with a chance for X-class flares (R3, Strong) on 11-13 Oct.
